Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about LUMIZA.

cordless.question: Is the lamp cordless?
cordless.answer: Yes. LUMIZA is designed to operate without a cable while in use and to be moved easily.

recharge.question: How is the lamp recharged?
recharge.answer: USB charging. Full recharge in 45 minutes, according to the manufacturer. Up to 4 hours of battery life, according to the manufacturer.

colors.question: Which colours are available?
colors.answer: LUMIZA comes in gold, black and silver. The options offered at checkout depend on available stock.

multiple.question: Can I order several lamps?
multiple.answer: Choose SOLO for one lamp, DUO for two or PRO for ten, then adjust the number of packs in your selection.

shipping.question: Do you ship outside France?
shipping.answer: Delivery is available to France, Belgium, Germany and Switzerland. Shipping charges are shown at checkout. Estimated delivery within {min}–{max} business days.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: Card payments are processed in Stripe’s secure interface. LUMIZA does not store your full card number.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.introduction: This page describes the main categories of data used by the LUMIZA shop and how they support its operation.

orders.title: Orders and delivery
orders.body: Checkout and order records contain the selected products, quantities, country, order reference and payment-related identifiers. Stripe may provide a customer's name and email after payment. Stripe collects delivery address information through its checkout interface; LUMIZA does not currently copy the full address into its order database.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Card entry takes place in Stripe's embedded payment interface. LUMIZA stores a Stripe checkout session identifier and, when available, a payment-intent identifier, not full card numbers.

technical.title: Technical data
technical.body: The cart is kept in local storage; a checkout-attempt identifier is kept in session storage. Theme and consent preferences may also be stored in this browser. Server and payment-provider logs may contain technical information needed for operation and security.

sharing.title: Service providers and rights
sharing.body: Supabase stores order data and Stripe processes payments. With your permission, Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity help analyse site use, while Meta Pixel follows the Marketing choice. Clarity may record interactions on public pages; it is not loaded on checkout or confirmation pages.

contact.title: Contact and exercising your rights
contact.description: If you have any questions about your personal data or wish to exercise your rights, you can contact us:

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.introduction: These terms and conditions set out the main conditions applicable to orders placed through the LUMIZA shop.

seller.title: Seller and products
seller.body: The LUMIZA shop offers its lamp in the finishes and packages available in the catalogue. The available options are shown on the product pages and during ordering.

prices.title: Prices and payment
prices.body: Prices are displayed in EUR. The applicable price is the one shown to the customer when placing the order, including the delivery charge for the selected country. Payment is processed through Stripe. LUMIZA does not store your full card number.

ordering.title: Ordering and confirmation
ordering.body: The customer chooses an offer and the available options, reviews the cart, selects a delivery country from the available destinations and provides the requested information. Payment is processed through Stripe. Once payment is validated, a confirmation page displays the order reference.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Supported destinations and per-order charges are set out in the seller information below. Estimated delivery within {min}–{max} business days.

Reviews.title: Already at home in their lives.
Reviews.description: Discover what buyers think of this lamp model.
Reviews.instructions: Swipe through the reviews or use the buttons or arrow keys.

pat.title: Good-quality product
pat.text: A good-quality product that matches the descriptions. Works very well and has good battery life once charged. I’m very satisfied with it.

stephane.title: Pretty and practical!!
stephane.text: A beautiful lamp, modern, practical and very pretty. Everyone loves it!!

jerome.title: Quality as expected
jerome.text: Touch controls OK. 3 light tones. Quality as expected, battery lasts quite a while.

norbert.title: Very good
norbert.text: Very good, especially the absence of a cord, which often gets in the way with conventional lamps.

boyer.title: Multi-function
boyer.text: I love it!! I saw it during an evening at friends’ and was won over. With its 3 mood-lighting colours, the lamp has plenty of charm!!

chris.title: Attractive and functional
chris.text: I’ve only had this product for 2 days and I find it attractive and very functional, with its light temperature and brightness settings.
